user.title: Entertainment Releases
user.description: Connect to TMDB. Detailed release filters are configured after setup.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to TMDB. Check your token.

theatrical.title: Configure Theatrical Releases
theatrical.description: Choose which upcoming movie releases should appear in the theatrical sensor. These filters are sent to TMDB Discover, with optional re-release filtering.

data_description.theatrical_exclude_rereleases: When enabled, older movies returning to theaters are removed when TMDB's returned release date falls outside the configured date window.
data_description.theatrical_certification: Select any certifications to include. Multiple selections use OR logic.
data_description.theatrical_sort_by_release_date: On: show the soonest releases first. Off: show the most popular movies first.

digital.title: Configure Digital Releases
digital.description: Choose which movie releases should appear in the digital sensor using TMDB Discover filters such as release type, genres, certification, language, score, votes, and runtime.

data_description.digital_certification: Select any certifications to include. Multiple selections use OR logic.

tv.title: Configure TV Shows
tv.description: Choose which shows should appear in the TV sensor. Filter by country, streaming services, genres, show type, language, ratings, runtime, and TMDB keywords you want excluded.

data_description.tv_excluded_keywords: Enter TMDB keyword names separated by commas. Example: Cooking, late-night show. A show is excluded if it matches any of them.

general.title: General Settings
general.description: Set how often Entertainment Releases refreshes its data from TMDB.
